chunks: And in the narration of ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from him, عليه السلام:
"If he hears the murmur, then he should not recite."

key_terms.الْهَمْهَمَةَ: a low murmur or subdued sound of recitation
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: Should a follower recite in congregational salat (prayer) if he hears the Imam's murmur?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding congregational salat (prayer). It indicates that when the follower hears the Imam's low recitation or murmur, he should refrain from reciting himself.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1158 - In a narration from Ubayd ibn Zurarah from Imam (as):
"If he (the follower) hears a murmur (of the Imam's recitation), he should not recite."
